target: Promote C1 and C5 contracts to L3: .v0->.v1 schema version bump and semver bump together, validation_state lifts (C5 split: paths CROSS_CHECKED, endpoint bindings stay PROVISIONAL), manifest level updates. The promotion diff itself is processed under B.6 with its own APPROVAL.json. Independent non-author audit mandatory. Redlane packet.
invariants: Never wire or import the merge seam (the queue drain or any live lane-merge path).
Never compute live SHAs for static fixtures — only allowed for runtime git reads explicitly carved out in design D-E.
Never self-certify — the auditor identity in the proof bundle must differ from the implementer; operator verifies before orchestrator advance.
Never bind ConPort, dope-memory, or task-orchestrator endpoints — no live service calls.
Never promote external corroboration (DR-015, DR-016) to repo authority — cite provenance tags as EXTERNAL_PROPOSED or REPO_VALIDATED.
LIVE_WRITE_READY remains undefined and blocking — classifier blocked-posture on any PROVISIONAL class that lacks an approval_policy.yaml entry.
schema_version (.v0->.v1) and contract_version semver MUST bump together at L3 — bumping one without the other is a spec violation (amendment A2).
C5 endpoint_bindings MUST remain PROVISIONAL at L3 — the split-state (paths CROSS_CHECKED, endpoint bindings PROVISIONAL) is the only sanctioned L3 variant (amendment A15).

Independent audit is MANDATORY — the auditor identity in the proof bundle must be verifiably different from the implementer; operator verifies before orchestrator advance. This is non-waivable for the formal lock.

Redlane packet: a hand-authored proof/DMX-DCP-TOOLING-112/APPROVAL.json (schema-valid, requester != approver, scoped to schemas/dcp/** and config/dcp/**) must be present in the proof bundle before this packet may be marked complete, per design B.6.

pr.title: feat(dcp): promote C1+C5 to L3 — .v0->.v1 lock (DMX-DCP-TOOLING-112)
pr.body:
## Summary
- Promotes C1 (dcp_red_lane_taxonomy) and C5 (project_resource_map) to L3 (LOCKED) per design Wave 4.
- schema_version const bumped from dcp-red-lane-taxonomy.v0 to dcp-red-lane-taxonomy.v1 (amendment A2: authority marker).
- contract_version semver bumped from 0.1.0 to 1.0.0 together with schema_version (A2: both bump at L3).
- validation_state lifts: C1 → LOCKED; C5 split per amendment A15 — path sections → REPO_CROSS_CHECKED (generated from taxonomy), endpoint_bindings → PROVISIONAL.
- Manifest level fields updated: C1.level='L3', C5.level='L3' with split-state documented.
- README.md updated with L3 authority marker and version precedence rule.
- The promotion diff touches schemas/dcp/** — processed under B.6 with its own APPROVAL.json.
- Independent non-author audit mandatory (non-waivable for formal lock).

## Validation
- Full dcp test suite passes.
- Both CI gates (dcp-red-lane-gate, dcp-contracts-consistency) green.
- Manifest cross-file consistency check passes.
- .v1 consumers treat contract as locked; .v0 consumers treat as provisional.
- C5 endpoint_bindings confirmed PROVISIONAL in manifest.

## NOT_RUN
- Plugin packaging (TP-114 depends on this lock).

steps.task: Preflight gate-check: confirm all L3 prerequisites are met. TP-104 (CI gate) merged → scanner invoked as direct CI step. TP-105 (surface_guard) merged → fallback equality test passing. TP-111 (resource-map builder) merged → drift gate in CI. Run the dcp contracts-consistency CI test to confirm current state.
commands: python -m pytest tests/dcp/ -k 'consistency or ci_gate or surface_guard or resource_map' -q
validation: All three dependency TPs (104, 105, 111) confirmed merged — their CI gates and tests passing.
Current manifest level and validation_state for C1 and C5 documented.
L3 gate preconditions (non-empty producers/consumers, CI gate listed) verified structurally.

steps.task: Bump schema_version const in dcp_red_lane_taxonomy.schema.json from dcp-red-lane-taxonomy.v0 to dcp-red-lane-taxonomy.v1. Update any consumers that hardcode the .v0 string to tolerate .v1. Update the const in the taxonomy instance file (config/dcp/red_lane_taxonomy.json) to match. Confirm the version precedence rule (A2): a consumer seeing .v0 treats the contract as provisional; .v1 = locked.

Update schemas/dcp/manifest.json: C1 entry — level='L3', contract_version='1.0.0', schema_version='dcp-red-lane-taxonomy.v1', validation_state='LOCKED', ci_gates confirmed non-empty and naming real CI job steps. C5 entry — level='L3', contract_version='1.0.0', validation_state split: 'REPO_CROSS_CHECKED' for path sections, 'PROVISIONAL' for endpoint_bindings, documented in manifest as the sanctioned L3(split) variant per amendment A15. Update README.md with L3 authority marker and version precedence rule.
validation: dcp-contracts-consistency CI test passes against updated manifest.

steps.task: Write proof/DMX-DCP-TOOLING-112/APPROVAL.json (hand-authored, redlane requirement per design B.6). The artifact must: be schema-valid against dcp_approval_artifact schema; have requester != approver; decision 'allow'; scope covering schemas/dcp/** and config/dcp/** paths touched in this packet. This is the gate proving itself — the promotion diff is a contract mutation and must flow through B.6.
validation: python -c "import json; a=json.load(open('proof/DMX-DCP-TOOLING-112/APPROVAL.json')); assert a['requester'] != a['approver']" exits 0.
python -c "import json; a=json.load(open('proof/DMX-DCP-TOOLING-112/APPROVAL.json')); assert a.get('decision') in ('allow','gated')" exits 0.
Approval scope covers schemas/dcp/** confirmed in artifact.

steps.task: Run the full dcp test suite and both CI gates. All tests must pass. Confirm diff scope is inside allowlist. Write PROOF.json recording: command outputs, exit codes, git state, validation_state before and after, PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN buckets. Record auditor identity (must differ from implementer — operator verifies).

PYTHONPATH=src uv run --frozen dopemux dcp resource-map sync --check
validation: python -m pytest tests/dcp/ -q exits 0 — zero failures.
git diff --name-only HEAD confirms only allowlist files changed.
Auditor identity in PROOF.json is verifiably different from implementer — operator has verified before advance.
BUILD_AFTER_CORE_CONTRACTS gate declared OPEN in proof.
